about: a plain factual question the model can answer as the requested JSON

json.chatInput: What are three good ways to keep basil alive on a windowsill?

branches: Basic LLM Chain success output → JSON to Object → Structured Response (expected when the model returns bare JSON with Prompt and Response); error output → Error Response if the chain fails
JSON to Object (type object) fails if the model wraps the JSON in prose or a code fence
expect.offline: No external read: the only call is the model. Ollama Model is the completion node lmOllama (POST /api/generate on the credential's base URL), not lmChatOllama; the reply is recorded at run time, so whether JSON to Object parses it is model-driven
